latvia.title: Prince of Courland Ernst Johann Biron dies aged 85
latvia.description: Ernst Johann Biron, Prince of Courland (1940–2026), descendant of Duke Peter von Biron of Courland, passed away on the night of June 19 at the age of 85, according to representatives of Rundāle Palace.

latvia.title: Latvian Midsummer 'online film festival' available worldwide
latvia.description: The National Film Center’s filmas.lv portal is hosting its traditional “Midsummer Festival,” which this year is centred on the history of cinema and the music calendar; specifically, 2026 marks more or less 'round number' anniversaries for many well-known Latvian composers who have also written music for great films, and the portal has curated a selection of ten films from the anniversary composers’ filmography.

latvia.title: Traditional Herb Market open in Rīga's Old Town
latvia.description: The traditional Herb Market opened on June 19 in Rīga’s Doma Square, offering everything needed for the colourful and tradition-rich Midsummer celebrations – Midsummer herbs, cheese, beer, and gifts. This year, more than 260 vendors are participating, and the market will be open until 7 p.m.

latvia.title: 'Digital television' case to be reviewed again in court
latvia.description: The Senate’s Criminal Division has reviewed the prosecutor’s appeal and overturned the Riga Regional Court’s ruling, which had found all defendants in the so-called second Digital Television criminal case not guilty and acquitted them. Several individuals were involved in the case, including Rīga City Council member Ainārs Šlesers (Latvia First) and former Prime Minister Andris Šķēle, Latvian Television reports.

latvia.title: Former President Levits receives Germany's highest honour
latvia.description: Latvia's former president Egils Levits has been awarded Germany’s highest honour for his decades-long dedication and services to German-Latvian relations.

latvia.title: Midsummer holiday will be hot in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that the weather in Latvia will be warm during the long holiday weekend, at times even hot and muggy.

latvia.title: Latvian army commander promoted to highest rank
latvia.description: On June 18, President Edgars Rinkēvičs issued an order promoting Kaspars Pudāns, Commander of the National Armed Forces (NBS), to the rank of lieutenant general, according to a statement from the President’s Office.

latvia.title: Extra public transport in Rīga on Midsummer Night
latvia.description: On Midsummer Night (June 23-24), additional public transportation will be available in Rīga, and travel will be free over the holidays, Baiba Bartaševiča-Feldmane, head of the Public Relations Department at "Rīgas satiksme," told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Safety tips ahead of Midsummer holidays in Latvia
latvia.description: The upcoming Midsummer holiday is prompting various services to mobilise, including medical personnel, firefighters, and food safety inspectors. Latvian Radio has compiled a reminder on basic safety tips for the holidays.

latvia.title: Reduced tax on diesel to stay until end of year in Latvia
latvia.description: The reduced excise tax rate on diesel fuel will remain in effect until the end of this year. This is provided for in the amendments to the Law on Limiting Price Increases for Petroleum Products, which the Saeima approved on Thursday, June 18.

latvia.title: Drone-related crimes to be punished more strictly in Latvia
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 18, the Saeima approved, in the final reading, amendments to the Criminal Law that strengthen criminal liability for crimes committed using airborne devices, such as balloons, drones, and weather probes, according to a statement from parliament.

latvia.title: Jelgava is on fire this weekend
latvia.description: The 14th International Large-Scale Ceramic Fire Sculpture Symposium is underway in Jelgava, on Pasta (Postal) Island. This year, four artists from Latvia, the United Kingdom, and Estonia are creating large-scale fireclay sculptures on the theme of identity, Zemgale Regional Television reported on June 18.

latvia.title: Russian, Belarusian investors' opportunities to live in Latvia restricted
latvia.description: On Thursday, the Saeima adopted amendments to the Immigration Law in its final reading, which would prevent citizens of Russia and Belarus from obtaining temporary residence permits through the investment program for alternative investment fund managers. LETA reports.

latvia.title: Latvian actor Enriko Avots dies
latvia.description: Latvian actor Enriko Avots (02.11.1952–14.06.2026), who worked at the Youth Theatre from 1976 to 1992 and later at the New Rīga Theatre and Latvian Television, has died, according to the Latvian Theatre Workers’ Union.

latvia.title: Sunny day on Friday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that Friday will be mostly sunny in Latvia.

latvia.title: Boy missing from Skrīveri, Latvia found
latvia.description: The State Police have successfully located the missing boy born in 2014, the police reported.

latvia.title: Chicken of the woods aplenty in Latvia
latvia.description: The annual hunting season for early spring edible mushrooms has come to an end. However, we still have to wait a little while longer for the start of the chanterelle season. Not to mention the start of the season for boletes and other late-summer mushrooms… What should mushroom-loving Latvians do now? Experienced gourmets know: head out to find some chicken of the wood!

latvia.title: Rīga is increasingly buggy
latvia.description: As Midsummer approaches and summer reaches its peak, urban meadows are in full bloom. This season, 27 habitats for invertebrates will be installed in Rīga to promote biodiversity in the urban environment, according to the Latvian Fund for Nature. Additionally, two more areas will be added to the city’s network of meadows this season.

latvia.title: Solar energy park opens in Tārgale, Ventspils
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 18, the Danish renewable energy developer "European Energy" opened a solar park in Tārgale, Ventspils. The solar park covers a total area of 138 hectares, the company reported.

latvia.title: Negative demographics trend continues in Latvia
latvia.description: In the first four months of this year, 3,642 newborns were registered in Latvia, which is 4.9% or 186 newborns fewer than during the same period in 2025, according to preliminary data released by the Central Statistical Bureau, LETA reports.

latvia.title: Final Latvian parliamentary sitting before summer recess on Thursday
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 18, the Latvian parliament, the Saeima, has its final sitting before summer recess.

latvia.title: Prison sentence for ethnic hate motivated assault in Latvia
latvia.description: The Kurzeme District Court has sentenced two individuals who, in July 2024, got into a conflict with a Ukrainian citizen at a public event in Ventspils Municipality, making hateful remarks related to his nationality and causing moderate bodily injury to other individuals as well, the court said on June 18.

latvia.title: Summer solstice events in Latvia
latvia.description: From peaceful wreath-making to lively outdoor dances – a spectacular program of solstice celebrations is in store across Latvia again this year. To help you navigate the wide range of events, here’s a glimpse into the various festivities.

latvia.title: Limbaži, Latvia has first watermelon harvest of year
latvia.description: It’s customary to see cheese and beer on the Midsummer table, but at the Kantāni gardens in Limbaži Municipality, homegrown watermelons are the centrepiece. Farmers Mareks and Aija Kantāni told Latvian Television’s programme Morning Panorama that the first harvest comes in even before the holiday.

latvia.title: Sea of peonies blossoms in Lielvārde, Latvia
latvia.description: It’s peony season in Latvia. They’re blooming in collectors’ gardens and backyard flower beds. The residents of Lielvārde know that many beautiful flowers can be found right in their own town, in Arta Jefimova’s garden. The 90-year-old woman has been growing peonies for a long time and she even refuses to accept money for the flowers, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: Hybrid war exhibition open at Latvian Occupation museum
latvia.description: June 17th marks the 86th anniversary of the day Soviet troops entered Latvia on June 17, 1940, and occupied it. On Wednesday, the Museum of the Occupation of Latvia opened an exhibition prepared by historian Kārlis Dambītis, The Hybrid War Against Latvia, 1939–1940, drawing parallels with current events, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: Many employees unhappy with LSM rebranding effort
latvia.description: More than 200 employees of Latvian Public Media (Latvijas Sabiedriskais medijs/LSM) are asking the board to retain the long-established brands "Latvijas Televīzija" (Latvian Television) and "Latvijas Radio" (Latvian Radio) rather than rolling everything into a unified 'LSM' brand in future as is currently planned.

latvia.title: “Interesanti, ko viņi darīs ar ietaupītajām 55 sekundēm?” Svētkos ceļi pilni un nervi uzvilkti
latvia.description: Par braukšanu alkohola reibumā pagājušajā diennaktī uz Latvijas autoceļiem pieķerti deviņi transportlīdzekļu vadītāji, aģentūrai LETA pavēstīja Valsts policijā. Par braukšanu alkohola reibumā četri transportlīdzekļu vadītāji pieķerti Rīgas reģionā, trīs Latgalē, bet pa vienam Zemgalē un Kurzemē. lithuania.description: Pete Hegseth szerint lesznek olyan országok, amelyek elbuknak az USA felülvizsgálatán, és lesznek olyanok is, amelyek kiváló eredménnyel teljesítenek. Sokakat J. D. Vance müncheni kioktatós beszédére emlékeztetett Hegseth kirohanása a brüsszeli NATO központban.

lithuania.description: Egyetlen éjszaka, két vébémeccs.

lithuania.title: Putyin nem találkozik Zelenszkijjel, Tu–160-asokkal demonstrált erőt Moszkva – Ukrajnai háborús híreink kedden
lithuania.description: Vlagyimir Putyin orosz elnök végzős hallgatók előtt mondott keddi beszédében kijelentette, mivel Ukrajna az orosz polgári infrastruktúrát támadja, neki nincs oka arra, hogy találkozzon Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán államfővel. Putyin szerint nem Oroszország indította a háborút, hanem a Nyugat provokálta Moszkvát, mikor az a saját érdekeit akarta érvényesíteni. Az orosz védelmi minisztérium közlése szerint Tu–160-as stratégiai bombázókkal tartottak tesztrepülést NATO-tagországok közelében, de nemzetközi vizek felett. A gyakorlat során más országok vadászgépei is felszálltak. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az ukrajnai háború eseményeivel.

lithuania.title: Putin v bubline klamstiev: Lotyšská tajná služba varuje pred ruskými provokáciami a reakciou NATO
lithuania.description: Pravdepodobnosť hybridných provokácií zo strany Ruska voči pobaltským štátom a Poľsku sa zvyšuje.

lithuania.title: Kauza účasti na summite NATO graduje, Pavel sa obrátil na ústavný súd. Babiš mu pripomenul Turka
lithuania.description: Súd už avizoval, že o žalobe rozhodne čo najskôr.

lithuania.title: Pavlovy kompetenční žaloby si všímají až v Singapuru
lithuania.description: Český prezident Petr Pavel oznámil, že podá kompetenční žalobu proti vládě poté, co ho vyškrtla jako českého zástupce na červencovém summitu NATO, napsal v úterý singapurský server The Straits Times. Není jediný, koho tuzemská kauza zaujala. Informuje o ní totiž téměř celý svět, včetně agentury Bloomberg, rumunské stanice Digi24, listu Politico nebo ruské agentury TASS.

lithuania.title: V Turecku a Německu zasahovala policie proti podezřelým s vazbami na islamisty
lithuania.description: Bezpečnostní složky v turecké metropoli Ankaře v úterý, dva týdny před summitem NATO, provedly rozsáhlé razie a zadržely více než 200 lidí podezřelých z napojení na extremistické skupiny, včetně teroristické sítě Islámský stát (IS). Podle některých médií jsou mezi nimi také politici či aktivisté, což vyvolává obavy ze svévolného zadržování, píše AP. Summitu se 7. a 8. července zúčastní zástupci všech 32 členských států Aliance, včetně amerického prezidenta Donalda Trumpa. Podobný zásah provedla ve stejný den také německá policie.

lithuania.title: Prezident podal kompetenční žalobu na vládu kvůli účasti na summitu NATO
lithuania.description: Ústavní soud obdržel prezidentovu kompetenční žalobu kvůli schválené delegaci na červencový summit NATO v Ankaře, do níž vláda prezidenta nezahrnula. Soud uvedl, že si je vědom naléhavosti věci, o přednostním projednání rozhodne plénum. Prezident Petr Pavel své rozhodnutí zdůvodnil v oficiálním vyjádření, kde mimo jiné uvádí, že rozhodnutí vlády vyloučit prezidenta z delegace na summit považuje za bezprecedentní a mimořádně nešťastný krok a omezení svých ústavních pravomocí.

lithuania.title: Putin acuză NATO că se pregătește de război cu Rusia și amenință cu represalii: „Suntem pregătiţi să răspundem”
lithuania.description: Președintele rus Vladimir Putin a acuzat marți NATO că se pregătește activ pentru un război împotriva Rusiei și a susținut că statele occidentale își sporesc bugetele militare folosind, în opinia sa, „afirmații false” despre o amenințare venită dinspre Moscova. Liderul de la Kremlin a transmis că Rusia este pregătită să răspundă „operațional și adecvat” la ceea ce consideră a fi amenințări interne și externe, potrivit dpa și Reuters.

lithuania.title: Sute de rețineri în Turcia, în urma unor raiduri antiteroriste, ca parte a măsurilor de pregătire a summitului NATO. Acuzele opoziției
lithuania.description: Autorităţile turce au reţinut marţi 209 de persoane în cadrul unor operaţiuni antiteroriste, au declarat procurorii, la o zi după ce Ankara a impus restricţii privind adunările publice în perspectiva summitului NATO de luna viitoare, relatează Reuters. Grupurile de opoziţie au afirmat că raidurile fac parte din ceea ce ele numesc o campanie mai amplă de reprimare a democraţiei şi a libertăţilor civice în Turcia.

lithuania.title: Președintele ceh îl dă în judecată pe premier în legătură cu participarea la summitul NATO
lithuania.description: Președintele ceh îl dă în judecată pe prim-ministru în legătură cu participarea la summitul NATO. Cea mai recentă escaladare a conflictului dintre cei doi adversari politici a ajuns în fața Curții Constituționale a țării, care urmează să examineze cazul miercuri, scrie POLITICO.

lithuania.title: Tucker Carlson părăsește Partidul Republican. Fostul susținător al lui Trump le-a adresat un avertisment membrilor partidului
lithuania.description: Comentatorul conservator Tucker Carlson se desparte oficial de Partidul Republican, după ce a fost timp de zeci de ani unul dintre cei mai influenți susținători ai acestuia în mass-media, scrie The Independent.

lithuania.title: Susținător al lui Călin Georgescu, vizat de percheziții după ce a imitat controalele lui Piedone pe TikTok
lithuania.description: Polițiștii din Timișoara au făcut, marți, o percheziție la locuința unui bărbat de 32 de ani, cunoscut pe TikTok și asociat în spațiul public cu susținerea lui Călin Georgescu, după ce acesta a publicat un videoclip în care apare îmbrăcat similar fostului șef al ANPC, Cristian Popescu Piedone, și simulează un control într-un magazin. Bărbatul este cercetat pentru uzurpare de calități oficiale.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu, avertisment către partide și Nicușor Dan: „Dacă vor ignora opoziția, vor pierde și guvernarea viitoare”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a afirmat marți, într-un mesaj pe rețelele sociale, că „a trecut vremea politicienilor combinatori” și avertizează partidele și pe președintele Nicușor Dan „să nu mai ignore opoziția”. În caz contrar, „vor pierde și guvernarea viitoare”, susține Peiu.

lithuania.title: Trump amenință din nou, cu privire la țările NATO: „Chiar am putea să o facem”
lithuania.description: Preşedintele american Donald Trump a ameninţat luni ţările NATO că nu le va ajuta dacă vor cere acest lucru, justificându-şi poziţia prin faptul că acestea nu au susţinut operaţiunea sa militară împotriva Iranului.

lithuania.title: Președintele ceh, interzis la summitul NATO de la Ankara: propriul guvern nu-l vrea pe Petr Pavel la Ankara
lithuania.description: Guvernul ceh a anunţat luni că nu îl va include pe preşedintele Petr Pavel, fost înalt funcţionar al NATO, în delegaţia cehă de la summitul alianţei de luna viitoare de la Ankara, rupând astfel tradiţia şi declanşând o dispută juridică cu şeful statului, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Alan Greenspan, cel mai influent guvernator al unei Bănci Centrale din epoca modernă, a murit la vârsta de 100 de ani
lithuania.description: Economistul american Allan Greenspan, care a condus Banca Centrală a Statelor Unite timp de aproape douăzeci de ani, a decedat luni, 22 iunie, la vârsta de 100 de ani, scrie Le Monde.

lithuania.title: Rusia acuză NATO și UE că pregătesc un nou plan „Barbarossa” pentru a cuceri țara lui Putin
lithuania.description: NATO și Uniunea Europeană se pregătesc pentru un conflict militar cu Rusia la începutul anului 2030, iar pregătirile lor seamănă din ce în ce mai mult cu planul „Barbarossa” — strategia Germaniei naziste de a ataca URSS, a declarat adjunctul șefului Ministerului Afacerilor Externe al Federației Ruse, Alexander Grushko.

lithuania.title: Peiu susține că Nicușor Dan și PSD presează AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea: „Asta ar aduce prăbuşirea partidului”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a afirmat, într-un mesaj pe rețelele sociale, că președintele Nicușor Dan și PSD pun presiune pe AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea. Însă acest lucru „ar aduce prăbuşirea” partidului, susține acesta.

lithuania.title: WATCH AGAIN: 20th Baltic states student song and dance festival 'Gaudeamus' grand concert
lithuania.description: From June 19th to 21st, Riga will host the XX Baltic Student Song and Dance Festival “Gaudeamus”, bringing together 5,000 students from Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia.

lithuania.title: Iš apkasų – į dronų lenktynes: viena diena su Ukrainos kariais
lithuania.description: Vienas paskui kitą du dronai pralėkė pro tunelį – vieną iš trasos kliūčių – ir nuskriejo link finišo linijos, netoli karuselės vaikų žaidimų aikštelėje. Kepsnių dūmų iš maisto kioskų apgaubti žiūrovai akylai žiūrėjo į didžiulį ekraną, kuriame lenktynių vaizdas buvo transliuojamas iš dronų perspektyvos.

lithuania.title: Ukrainoje žuvo anksčiau dingusiu laikytas savanoris iš Lietuvos
lithuania.description: Paskelbta skaudi žinia iš Ukrainos fronto: nuo birželio pradžios dingusiu be žinios laikytas 25-erių metų lietuvis karys Ignas Kailius žuvo mūšio lauke.
